messages:
ravi (eng-ml): quick proposal: add a lightweight canary stage between microbench and deep-eval. Purpose: route 1% traffic for 2h, sample latency/quality in real traffic without full rollout.

mira (eng-platform): +1. we need an API flag in descriptor: \"canary_percent\" and \"canary_duration_mins\". Also require an immutable run id for traceability.

oscar (eng-sre): SRE constraints: canary must auto-cut if error rate > X or p95 > 2x baseline for 10m. Also limit concurrent canaries per-region to avoid blast radius.

jess (product): customers will want to opt-out of canarying for private deployments. add a per-tenant switch and explain in docs.

tara (qa): For quality checks during canary, sample both golden prompts and recent real prompts (anonymized). If quality delta > thresh -> create triage ticket with diffs and repro artifact.

ravi (eng-ml): Implementation notes: descriptor-v3 fields: {"model_id","commit","seqlen_hints","quant_candidates","replay_artifact","canary_percent","canary_duration_mins","run_id"}. Will add replay seeds.

mira (eng-platform): Console will show canary state + quick snapshot metrics (p50,p95,error_rate,quality_delta). Also a manual abort button that uses the run_id to rollback.

oscar (eng-sre): Add alerting: canary abort due to metric breach -> create paged incident if customer SLA impacted; otherwise log and auto-abort.

lab-bot: canary-job queued: onboard/canary/1822223333/run-0001

ravi (eng-ml): I'll write RFC with state transitions, descriptor v3, metric thresholds, and runbook. owners: ravi (design), mira (platform), tara (qa), oscar (SRE). Will post draft today.

jess (product): please include docs for tenants and opt-out steps. SGTM.
